statusLine.command: crabswarm statusline render '{{ $m := .Model.DisplayName }}{{ with .Effort }}{{ $m = print $m " @ " .Level }}{{ end }}{{ padRuneRight 18 $m }} | {{ padRuneLeft 9 (print .ContextWindow.UsedPercentage "% used") }} | {{ $r := .Workspace.CurrentDir }}{{ with .Worktree }}{{ $r = print $r " | " .Name }}{{ end }}{{ if gt columns 38 }}{{ $t := truncRuneLeft (len (slice (padRuneLeft columns "") 38)) $r }}{{ if ne $t $r }}…{{ end }}{{ $t }}{{ else }}{{ $r }}{{ end }}'
